medium: exasperation, the hot air in my lungs
high: rage burns hot in my veins
this is an outrage
a scream rests ragged in my throat
my bones become hatred
raze it all

medium: i thought I saw a shadow
high: we need to get out of here
something terrible, just beyond my vision
it's coming
deer on its hind legs
i whistled at night

medium: action hesitates on the tip of my tongue
high: cross no bridges when they come
this is who i am and always will be
sinew laden with concrete, unchanging
i am the immovable object
people do not change

low: there is work and little else
high: oh to be alive
i love and i love and i love
the fabric of the world is music
i rise and i dance
all cups, half full--and filling still

low: sit and wait and think about it
medium: maybe catch glitter in the sunbeam
bugs might whisper secrets of the universe
high: every sun is my brother
pidgeons float like silk on the wind I chase
i found god in my dog's eyes
your every word, a piano's chord
every moment a small infinity

low: i hear nothing in the shadows
medium: if it lurks invisible, so be it
there may be spiders in hidden corners
they can only hurt me if i let them
high: ghosts wail from the floorboards
demon claws clinging to my back
i run, but memory runs faster
my own life's knuckles creak around my throat
our history has fangs dripping with venom

medium: sadness, but its blade is dull
it hurts and it hurts and someday it won't
high: grief is no passing storm; it lingers immortal
shadows in the sunlight, only shadows
anguish grows like thorned vines between my ribs
tears live on the plains of my face
all i can do is to lay here and cry

low: all i need to consider is here and now
medium: feet grounded, head in the clouds
let us listen to the whispers in the wind
read between the world's stilted lines
perhaps there is more, after all
high: endless worlds nested into our own
look at your hands; those elements once burned as starfire
more than anything, those galaxies weave meaning
my soul in the earth, and yours there, too
our atoms, never to touch--yet still we feel
